reason: 该插件的主要用户价值是通过“技能与 MCP”设置界面集中管理 dsh 的技能与 MCP 配置，包括列表查看、开关、编辑、导入与市场安装。证据显示它涉及本地技能/MCP 文件与配置读写（含目录扫描、同步）以及从外部源下载仓库内容，因此属于外部服务整合型的设置管理工具，风险主要集中在配置与文件/网络导入路径。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 dsh 设置页提供技能与 MCP 的集中管理入口，支持配置技能列表、MCP 服务器、仓库来源及导入外部配置，便于统一维护调用能力。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a DSH Settings UI for centralized management of Skills and MCP, including listing and editing entries, repository sources, and importing from external configurations.

reasons.code: README states the plugin manages skills in dsh settings, and allows creating, editing, and deleting skill entries stored under local skill paths ($DSH_HOME/skills) via UI actions.
README describes importing and synchronizing skill and MCP sources from Claude Code and Codex directories/configs, including parsing and populating form fields automatically.
README explains support for adding local or GitHub skill repositories and downloading/unpacking GitHub repos to local storage before making them available in the skills list.
README details MCP page editing of profile patch server entries and reloading/restart flow required for changes to take effect.
